newsitem.title: USA: Equity Residential to buy 48 properties.
newsitem.headline: Equity Residential to buy 48 properties.

text.p: Equity Residential Properties Trust said Thursday it intends to acquire 48 properties from CAPREIT, a private real estate investment trust, for $633 million.

Equity Residential said it signed a non-binding letter of intent with CAPREIT, which is based in Rockville, Md., for the transaction, which involves 11,277 units. The portfolio is encumbered by about $400 million of mortgage debt, and Equity Residential may assume all or some of it.

The companies plan to negotiate a binding contract that will be subject to due diligence and other conditions and approvals. Equity Residential said there can be no assurance a deal will be completed.
